Al Arabia Carpets is a home furnishing and flooring company in Doha, with a showroom on Al Mansoura St. For more than 10 years we have supplied and installed the products below for villas, majlis, offices, mosques and shops across Qatar, with free delivery and installation.
: Wall-to-wall carpet, rugs, stair carpet and mosque carpet for every room. From QAR 80 per sqm.

Al Arabia Carpets has a showroom on Al Mansoura St in Doha, open every day from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM. You can see samples in person, or ask us to bring them to you. We deliver and install free of charge in Doha, Al Rayyan, Al Wakra, Al Khor, Lusail and the rest of Qatar, and measurement and quotation are free.
We have more than 10 years of experience and over 1000 customers in Qatar. To order, send us your room sizes and a few photos on WhatsApp, or ask us to visit and measure.
Also supplied and fitted across Qatar
Where can I buy carpets and flooring in Doha?

Al Arabia Carpets has a showroom on Al Mansoura St in Doha, open every day from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM. We supply carpets, barkia and PVC flooring, curtains, majlis sofas and interior fit-out across Qatar.
Does Al Arabia Carpets offer free delivery and installation?
Yes. Delivery and installation are free across Qatar, including Doha, Al Rayyan, Al Wakra, Al Khor and Lusail. Consultation, measurement and quotation are free as well.
How much do carpets and barkia cost in Qatar?
At Al Arabia Carpets, carpets start from QAR 80 per sqm and barkia starts from QAR 75 per sqm. The final price depends on the material and the area, and we quote it free after measuring.
How do I get a quote from Al Arabia Carpets?
Message us on WhatsApp at +974 5551 2858 with your room sizes and a few photos, or visit the showroom. If you are unsure of the sizes, we visit, measure on site and recommend the right material.
Can I see samples before I decide?
Yes. You can compare carpet, barkia and SPC flooring samples, curtain fabrics and majlis upholstery in person at our showroom in Doha, or we can bring samples to you when we visit to measure.
Does Al Arabia Carpets work with offices, mosques and businesses?
Yes. As well as homes and villas, we supply and fit carpet, flooring and curtains for offices, mosques, shops and event spaces across Qatar.
Get in touch with our team for personalized recommendations and a free quote. We're here to bring your vision to life.

سجاد وموكيت وأرضيات وستائر وأثاث في قطر

سجاد العربية شركة مفروشات منزلية وأرضيات في الدوحة، ولها معرض في شارع المنصورة. منذ أكثر من 10 سنوات نوفر ونركّب المنتجات التالية للفلل والمجالس والمكاتب والمساجد والمحلات في جميع أنحاء قطر، مع توصيل وتركيب مجاني.
: موكيت من الجدار إلى الجدار وسجاد وسجاد درج وسجاد مساجد لكل غرفة. ابتداءً من 80 ر.ق للمتر المربع.
: أرضيات باركيه و PVC و SPC مقاومة للماء للفلل والمطابخ وغرف العائلة كثيرة الحركة. ابتداءً من 75 ر.ق للمتر المربع.
: ستائر حسب المقاس وستائر رول، بأقمشة تقدر تشوفها في معرضنا. ابتداءً من 850 ر.ق للقطعة.
: جلسات مجالس وكنب حسب الطلب، تُصنع على مقاس الغرفة. ابتداءً من 850 ر.ق للقطعة.
: تشطيبات داخلية تشمل أعمال الجبس والخزائن وألواح الجدران ووحدات التلفزيون، مع عرض سعر مجاني بعد المعاينة.

لدى سجاد العربية معرض في شارع المنصورة بالدوحة، يفتح يوميًا من 8:00 صباحًا إلى 10:00 مساءً. تقدر تشوف العينات على الطبيعة، أو تطلب منا نجيبها لك. التوصيل والتركيب مجانًا في الدوحة والريان والوكرة والخور ولوسيل وباقي مناطق قطر، والقياس وعرض السعر مجانًا.
لدينا خبرة تزيد على 10 سنوات وأكثر من 1000 عميل في قطر. للطلب، أرسل لنا مقاسات الغرف وبعض الصور على الواتساب، أو اطلب منا زيارتك والقياس في الموقع.
نورّد ونركّب أيضًا في جميع أنحاء قطر
من أين أشتري السجاد والموكيت والأرضيات في الدوحة؟
لدى سجاد العربية معرض في شارع المنصورة بالدوحة، يفتح يوميًا من 8:00 صباحًا إلى 10:00 مساءً. نوفر السجاد والموكيت وأرضيات الباركيه و PVC والستائر وكنب المجالس والتشطيبات الداخلية في جميع أنحاء قطر.
هل توفر سجاد العربية التوصيل والتركيب مجانًا؟
نعم. التوصيل والتركيب مجانًا في جميع أنحاء قطر، بما فيها الدوحة والريان والوكرة والخور ولوسيل. والاستشارة والقياس وعرض السعر مجانًا كذلك.
كم أسعار السجاد والباركيه في قطر؟
في سجاد العربية، يبدأ سعر السجاد ابتداءً من 80 ر.ق للمتر المربع، ويبدأ سعر الباركيه ابتداءً من 75 ر.ق للمتر المربع. السعر النهائي يعتمد على الخامة والمساحة، ونعطيك عرض السعر مجانًا بعد القياس.
كيف أحصل على عرض سعر من سجاد العربية؟
راسلنا على الواتساب +974 5551 2858 مع مقاسات الغرف وبعض الصور، أو زر المعرض. وإذا ما كنت متأكد من المقاسات، نزورك ونقيس في الموقع ونرشح لك الخامة المناسبة.
هل يمكنني رؤية العينات قبل أن أقرر؟
نعم. يمكنك مقارنة عينات السجاد والباركيه وأرضيات SPC وأقمشة الستائر وتنجيد المجالس على الطبيعة في معرضنا بالدوحة، أو نحضر لك العينات عند زيارتك للقياس.
هل تعمل سجاد العربية مع المكاتب والمساجد والشركات؟
نعم. إلى جانب البيوت والفلل، نوفر ونركّب السجاد والأرضيات والستائر للمكاتب والمساجد والمحلات وأماكن المناسبات في جميع أنحاء قطر.
تواصل مع فريقنا واحصل على توصيات تناسبك وعرض سعر مجاني. حيّاكم، ونحن هنا لنحوّل فكرتك إلى واقع.

Al Arabia Carpets supplies and fits carpet across Qatar for homes, majlis, mosques, offices and event spaces. Our range covers wall-to-wall broadloom, carpet tiles, stair runners and made-to-measure rugs in a wide choice of pile heights and colours.

Carpet for offices, events and outdoor areas
Beyond wall-to-wall carpet for homes and majlis, three other kinds of carpet work make up much of what we do in Qatar, and each is handled differently from a domestic fit.

Office carpet is normally supplied as carpet tiles and fitted around working hours, so a floor can be re-covered without the business closing. Event carpet is laid to a venue's access window, usually overnight, and lifted once the event closes. Grass carpet is an outdoor product laid over a compacted, free-draining base rather than straight onto sand.

Do you measure and fit carpet in Doha?
Yes. We carry out a free on-site measurement anywhere in Doha and across Qatar, then cut, lay and finish the carpet for you. Both delivery and fitting are included.
What types of carpet do you supply?
We supply wall-to-wall broadloom, carpet tiles for offices, stair carpet, mosque and prayer-hall carpet, event carpet and made-to-measure rugs.
How long does carpet installation take?
A typical room is fitted the same day. Larger areas such as mosques or full office floors are scheduled in advance, and we confirm the timeline after measuring.
What is the difference between carpet tiles and wall-to-wall carpet?

Carpet tiles are laid as individual squares, so a stained or worn tile is lifted and replaced without touching the rest of the floor. Wall-to-wall broadloom is a continuous surface with no visible grid, which looks better in rooms where the floor is seen as a whole.
Which carpet is best for a high-traffic area?

A short, dense pile in a mid-tone colour. Long piles flatten in walkways and show every track, while very light and very dark colours both show marks. In offices and corridors we would normally recommend contract-grade carpet tiles for the same reason.
Do you supply carpet for mosques and events?
Yes, both. We supply and fit prayer-hall carpet with the traditional row markings, and we lay event carpet for exhibitions, conferences and weddings, usually overnight, then lift it afterwards.
Can you re-carpet an office without closing it?

Yes. Office floors are normally fitted in phases in the evenings or at weekends, department by department. Furniture is moved aside, the area is laid and put back, and the space is usable again the next working morning.
Do you lay artificial grass as well as carpet?

Yes. Grass carpet is laid for villa gardens, roof terraces, play areas and entrance steps. The important part is the base underneath it: laid over compacted, free-draining material it stays flat, whereas grass laid straight onto sand develops dips within a couple of years.

أي سجاد هو الأفضل للمناطق كثيرة الحركة؟

سجاد بوبر قصير كثيف وبلون متوسط الدرجة. فالوبر الطويل ينضغط في الممرات وتظهر عليه كل الآثار، بينما تُظهر الألوان الفاتحة جدًا والداكنة جدًا العلامات بوضوح. ولهذا السبب نفسه نوصي عادةً في المكاتب والممرات بمربعات موكيت من الفئة التجارية.
هل توفّرون سجاد مساجد وسجاد مناسبات؟
نعم، كليهما. نورّد ونركّب سجاد مساجد لقاعات الصلاة بخطوط الصفوف التقليدية، ونفرش سجاد المناسبات للمعارض والمؤتمرات وحفلات الزفاف، عادةً خلال الليل، ثم نرفعه بعد انتهائها.
هل يمكنكم تجديد موكيت مكتب دون إغلاقه؟

نعم. تُركَّب أرضيات المكاتب عادةً على مراحل في المساء أو في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع، قسمًا بعد قسم. يُزاح الأثاث جانبًا، ثم تُفرش المساحة ويُعاد الأثاث إلى مكانه، فتصبح جاهزة للاستخدام صباح يوم العمل التالي.
هل تركّبون العشب الصناعي إلى جانب السجاد؟

نعم. نفرش العشب الصناعي لحدائق الفلل وأسطح المنازل ومناطق اللعب ودرجات المداخل. والأهم هو القاعدة التي تحته: فإذا فُرش فوق مادة مدكوكة جيدة التصريف بقي مستويًا، أما إذا فُرش فوق الرمل مباشرة فتظهر فيه انخفاضات خلال عامين تقريبًا.
أي نوع من السجاد يناسب كل غرفة، وكيف يؤثر ارتفاع الوبر في التحمل والتنظيف، والواقع العملي للغبار والتكييف في قطر.
مربعات موكيت المكاتب: دليل لأماكن العمل في قطر
مربعات أم موكيت متصل، وما الذي يتآكل أسرع، ولماذا تهم الصوتيات أكثر مما يتوقعه الناس، وكيف يتم التركيب دون إغلاق المكتب.
عشب صناعي في قطر: دليل عملي
ارتفاع الوبر والتصريف والحرارة وأشعة UV: ما الذي ينبغي تحديده، ولماذا تحدد القاعدة تحته شكله بعد ثلاث سنوات.
التخطيط لسجاد مناسبات في قاعة بقطر
مواعيد الدخول، وفئة لمرة واحدة أو لإعادة الاستخدام، وقواعد اللصق في القاعة، والأسئلة التي يجب حسمها قبل ليلة التركيب.
الأرضيات في قطر: الخيارات والأسعار وكيف تختار المورد
ما يميز كل نوع من الأرضيات، وبكم يبدأ سعره، والأسئلة التي تكشف لك المورد الموثوق.
الألوان المحايدة السادة، والنقوش الهندسية الهادئة، والأوبار ذات الملمس، وكيف تختار سجادًا عصريًا يناسب الغرفة.
من أين تحصل على السجاد في قطر

لدى سجاد العربية معرض في شارع المنصورة بالدوحة، يفتح يوميًا من 8:00 صباحًا إلى 10:00 مساءً. تقدر تشوف العينات على الطبيعة، أو تطلب منا نجيبها لك. التوصيل والتركيب مجانًا في الدوحة والريان والوكرة والخور ولوسيل وباقي مناطق قطر، والقياس وعرض السعر مجانًا.

Do you measure and install curtains in Doha?
Yes. We measure your windows free of charge, make the curtains to those measurements, and fit them along with the track or pole. Installation is included.
Do blackout curtains help with the heat?
Yes. A lined blackout curtain blocks direct sun and reduces the heat coming through the glass, which noticeably helps in rooms that take the afternoon sun.
Can I combine sheers with blackout curtains?
Yes, layering is common. A sheer keeps daytime privacy while letting light through, with a blackout curtain closing over it at night. We fit a double track for this.
How long do made-to-measure curtains take?

Usually a couple of weeks from the measuring visit, and the fabric normally sets the pace rather than the making. If a fabric has to be ordered in we tell you at quotation stage rather than after you have committed to it.

Roller and vertical blinds, in most cases. Both control glare on screens without darkening the room the way a curtain does, they take up almost no space at the window, and they are far easier to keep clean in a working office than fabric curtains.
How do I measure for curtains?

You do not need to. Measuring is the step most likely to go wrong, since it depends on the track position, the heading type and how far the curtain should extend past the glass. We measure free of charge and take responsibility for the result.

Wallpaper lives or dies on preparation. Most of the failures we are called to fix — lifting seams, bubbles, a pattern that drifts out of true across a wall — trace back to a wall that was not made good before hanging, not to the paper itself.

We supply the wallpaper as well as fit it, so one team answers for the paper, the wall underneath and the finish. We prepare the surface, hang the paper and finish the edges, working across homes, offices, majlis and retail spaces in Qatar. Send us the room. Message us on WhatsApp with photos and rough dimensions, and we will tell you straight away whether the wall needs work before papering.
Free survey. We visit, measure each wall, check the surface condition and confirm how many rolls the pattern repeat will need.
Quotation. A written quote covering preparation, materials and hanging, with no separate charge for delivery or fitting.

Do you supply the wallpaper as well as fit it?

Yes. We supply and fit wallpaper across Qatar. Because the same team orders the paper and prepares the wall, the roll count, the pattern repeat and the wall condition are all checked before anything is bought.
Do you prepare the wall before hanging wallpaper?
Yes, and it is included. We fill, sand and size the surface first. Skipping that step is the single most common cause of seams lifting and bubbles appearing later, so we do not quote without it.
Yes. Stripping the old paper and making the wall good is part of the quote when there is existing wallpaper in place. We would rather strip it than hang over it.
How much wallpaper will my room need?

It depends on the pattern repeat as much as the wall area — a large drop match wastes considerably more than a plain paper. We calculate the roll count during the survey so you are not left short mid-wall.
Is wallpaper practical in Qatar's humidity?
In air-conditioned rooms, yes. For bathrooms and other consistently humid areas we would recommend a vinyl or washable paper, or suggest wall panelling instead.
How long does wallpaper installation take?

A single feature wall is usually hung in a few hours and a full room within a day, once preparation is done. Where a wall needs stripping, filling and sanding first, we allow an extra day so the filler is properly dry before any paper goes onto it.
Should I choose wallpaper or wall panelling?

Wallpaper is cheaper, comes in far more patterns and suits bedrooms and living rooms. Panelling is more hard-wearing, adds real physical depth and copes better with knocks and humidity. For a TV wall or a busy hallway we would usually point you at panelling.

Standard-width units almost never add up to the length of a real wall, so the gaps get hidden behind filler panels. Building to measure uses the full run and turns corners into usable storage rather than dead space.
Can you replace a kitchen without redoing the whole room?
Usually yes. If the plumbing and electrical positions are staying put, we can remove the old units and install new cabinetry without touching the rest of the room.
Do you handle the flooring at the same time?
Yes, and it is generally easier. We supply barkia, SPC and vinyl flooring as well, so the floor and the cabinetry can be sequenced properly rather than coordinated between two contractors.
How long does a kitchen take?
It depends on the size of the run and the finish selected. We give a firm lead time with the quotation, once the layout and materials are settled.
Can you replace just the cabinet doors?

Yes, where the carcasses are sound. New doors and handles change the look of a kitchen for a fraction of a full replacement and take a day or two rather than a week. We check the carcasses and hinges first and tell you honestly whether they are worth keeping.
How do you allow for appliances?

We plan the cabinetry around the appliances you are keeping or buying, so tell us the models at the survey. Built-in ovens, hobs and fridges each have specific housing dimensions, and discovering a mismatch on delivery day means rebuilding a unit.

How much does a built-in wardrobe cost in Qatar?
It depends on the wall width and height, the door type and how much internal fitting you want, so we quote after measuring the room. The survey and the written quotation are free.
How much extra storage does a built-in wardrobe give?

Usually a good deal. A freestanding unit wastes the space between its top and the ceiling and leaves gaps at each side. Running floor to ceiling and wall to wall recovers all of it, and the recovered area is genuinely usable with a proper interior.

Sliding doors need no clearance in front, which matters in a bedroom where the bed sits close to the wardrobe. Hinged doors let you see the whole interior at once and cost less. We will recommend based on how much floor clearance the room actually has.
Can you fit a wardrobe to a sloped or uneven wall?
Yes. We scribe the unit to the wall and ceiling during installation, which closes the gaps that make a built-in look like a freestanding unit pushed into place.
Do you fit out dressing rooms as well?
Yes. A dressing room is the same work at a larger scale — the layout planning matters more, since there is usually a mix of hanging lengths, drawers and shoe storage to balance.
What is the difference between a wardrobe and a room cabinet?

They are built the same way; the difference is what goes inside. A wardrobe is planned around hanging space, a room cabinet around shelves and drawers for linen, documents or general storage. We make both, and most bedrooms end up with a mix of the two.
Can you build room cabinets into an alcove or corridor?

Yes, and it is where fitted cabinetry earns its cost. An alcove or corridor recess is dead space that no freestanding unit fits properly. Cabinets scribed to the walls turn it into full-height storage without losing any usable floor area.

Parquet is a decision about pattern before it is a decision about colour. Herringbone, chevron and basketweave each change how a room reads: they draw the eye along a particular line, and in a hallway or a formal room that effect does more work than the shade of the wood.

We supply and lay real wood parquet and laminate across Qatar in all the common formats. Where a room needs to be fully waterproof, our SPC range covers the same looks in a format that tolerates water — worth comparing before you decide.

Do you supply real wood parquet?

Yes. We supply and lay real wood parquet as well as laminate. Real wood suits dry rooms where you want a genuine timber surface. Where a room sees water, we would point you to SPC instead, which gives a similar look in a waterproof board.
What is the difference between herringbone and chevron?

Herringbone lays rectangular blocks at right angles, so the ends form a stepped zig-zag. Chevron cuts the ends at an angle so they meet in a continuous point, making a cleaner V. Chevron costs more because of the angled cutting.
Which laying pattern suits my room?

Herringbone and chevron are at their best in hallways, dining rooms and formal reception spaces, where the pattern is read as a whole. In a large open-plan room a straight or random-length plank is usually calmer and less expensive to lay.
Is parquet or laminate suitable for wet areas?
Not really. For bathrooms, kitchens and anywhere that regularly sees water we would point you at our SPC range, which offers the same herringbone and plank looks in a fully waterproof board.

It matters more here than for a plain plank floor. A patterned lay accumulates any error across the room, so a floor that is out of level shows as a pattern drifting out of true. We check and level before laying.
How long does parquet flooring take to lay?

A single room in a straight plank pattern is usually laid within a day. Herringbone and chevron take longer because every board is cut and fitted individually, so allow two to three days for a room, plus any time needed to level the sub-floor beforehand.
Can parquet be laid over existing tiles?

Usually yes, provided the tiles are sound and flat, and it avoids the cost and mess of lifting them. We check for loose tiles and deep grout lines at the survey, because both telegraph through a floating floor if they are not levelled first.

نورد ونركب الباركيه الخشبي الطبيعي واللامينيت في أنحاء قطر بجميع الأشكال الشائعة. وحيث تحتاج الغرفة إلى مقاومة كاملة للماء، تقدم مجموعتنا من أرضيات SPC الأشكال نفسها بصيغة تتحمل الماء، ومن المفيد المقارنة بينهما قبل أن تقرر.

ما الفرق بين عظم السمكة والشيفرون؟

في عظم السمكة تُركَّب قطع مستطيلة بزوايا قائمة، فتشكل أطرافها خطًا متعرجًا متدرجًا. أما الشيفرون فتُقص أطرافه بزاوية لتلتقي في رأس متصل على هيئة سهم أكثر انتظامًا. والشيفرون أعلى تكلفة بسبب القص المائل.

يظهر عظم السمكة والشيفرون في أفضل حالاتهما في الممرات وغرف الطعام وصالات الاستقبال الرسمية، حيث يُرى النقش بأكمله. أما في الغرفة المفتوحة الكبيرة فالألواح المستقيمة أو بأطوال عشوائية أهدأ عادةً وأقل تكلفة في التركيب.
هل يناسب الباركيه أو اللامينيت الأماكن الرطبة؟
ليس فعليًا. للحمامات والمطابخ وكل مكان يتعرض للماء بانتظام نوجهك إلى مجموعتنا من أرضيات SPC، التي تقدم أشكال عظم السمكة والألواح نفسها بألواح مقاومة للماء بالكامل.
هل تحتاج الأرضية الأساسية إلى تجهيز؟
الأمر هنا أهم مما هو عليه في الألواح السادة. فالتركيب المنقوش يراكم أي خطأ على امتداد الغرفة، فتظهر الأرضية غير المستوية في صورة نقش ينحرف عن استقامته. ولذلك نفحص ونسوي قبل التركيب.

تُركَّب الغرفة الواحدة بنمط الألواح المستقيمة عادةً خلال يوم. أما عظم السمكة والشيفرون فيستغرقان وقتًا أطول لأن كل قطعة تُقص وتُركَّب على حدة، فخصص يومين إلى ثلاثة أيام للغرفة، إضافة إلى أي وقت لازم لتسوية الأرضية الأساسية مسبقًا.
هل يمكن تركيب الباركيه فوق السيراميك الموجود؟

نعم في الغالب، بشرط أن يكون السيراميك سليمًا ومستويًا، وهذا يجنبك تكلفة خلعه وما يصاحبها من فوضى. ونفحص أثناء المعاينة وجود قطع مفككة أو فواصل عميقة، لأن كليهما يظهر أثره عبر الأرضية العائمة إن لم تتم تسويته أولًا.
PVC أم SPC، وأي سماكة تطلب، وأي الغرف تحتاج إلى أرضية مقاومة للماء بالكامل، وما يشمله التركيب الصحيح.

Event carpet is judged on two things: how the floor looks when the doors open, and whether it was finished in time. Neither is really about the carpet. Both come down to how much of a venue a team can cover between the last contractor leaving and the first guest arriving.

We supply and lay event carpet across Qatar for exhibitions, conferences, weddings, product launches and VIP arrivals. Most of this work happens overnight, because an out-of-hours slot is usually the only access a venue will give.

How much does event carpet cost in Qatar?
Event carpet starts from QAR 22 per sqm, supplied and laid. The final price depends on the floor area, the grade and the access window, and we confirm it in a written quote after the site visit.
How quickly can you lay event carpet?

For a single hall we can usually mobilise within 48 hours of confirmation and lay overnight, so the space is ready the following morning. For large exhibition floors we ask for about a week so we can order the colour and put enough fitters on site.
Do you install outside venue opening hours?

Yes, and it is how most event carpet gets laid. Venues rarely give daytime access, so we work overnight or early morning inside whatever window you have been allocated, and hand the floor over finished.
Is a one-off carpet cheaper than a reusable one?

We supply and lay event carpet rather than renting it. For a one-off event, laying a budget grade and disposing of it afterwards is normally the cheapest route. If you run several events a year, buying a heavier carpet that can be lifted, stored and relaid usually costs less across the year.

Will the carpet damage the venue floor?

No. We fix using tapes appropriate to the venue's floor finish and to whatever the venue permits, and we lift everything afterwards. If the venue has specific rules on adhesives, tell us at the survey and we will work to them.
Do you remove the carpet after the event?
Yes. Lifting, clearing and disposal are quoted in from the start rather than added later. If you are keeping the carpet for reuse we lift it carefully, roll it and leave it ready for storage.

That is why most offices we fit end up on carpet tiles rather than broadloom: when a tile is stained or worn you lift that tile and drop in a new one, instead of re-carpeting the room.

Carpet also does acoustic work that hard flooring cannot. In an open-plan office it takes the edge off footfall and chair movement, which is usually the difference between a room people can concentrate in and one they cannot.

How much does office carpet cost in Qatar?

Office carpet tiles start from QAR 70 per sqm, supplied and fitted. The final price depends on the area, the grade and how the work is phased around your team, and we confirm it in a written quote after a free survey.
Are carpet tiles better than broadloom for an office?

For most offices, yes. A damaged tile is lifted and swapped in minutes, whereas a stain on broadloom means living with it or re-carpeting the room. Broadloom still wins in boardrooms and cellular offices where the seamless look matters more than patch repairs.
Can you fit carpet without closing the office?

Yes. We normally phase the work floor by floor or department by department, and fit in the evenings or at weekends. Desks are moved, the area is laid and put back, and the space is usable the next working morning.
Does office carpet help with noise?

Noticeably, in open-plan space. Carpet absorbs footfall and chair movement rather than reflecting it the way hard flooring does, which lowers the background noise level people are trying to concentrate through. It is one of the main reasons open-plan offices are carpeted.
How long does office carpet last?

A contract-grade carpet tile in a normal office holds up for many years, and because tiles are replaced individually the floor does not have a single end-of-life date. Corridors and lift lobbies wear fastest, which is why we leave spare tiles from the same batch.
Do you take the old carpet away?
Yes. Uplift and disposal of the existing floorcovering are included in the quote rather than charged as an extra, and we clear the site at the end of each phase.
Why do you leave spare tiles?

Because dye lots change. A tile bought in two years' time will not match exactly, so we leave attic stock from your own batch. When a tile is later damaged, the replacement is invisible instead of an obvious patch.

Vinyl flooring has changed a great deal. The rigid-core boards we fit now are a long way from the sheet vinyl the name still brings to mind: they click together over the existing floor, they are fully waterproof, and the better wood effects are difficult to tell from real timber until you touch them.

That waterproofing is what makes vinyl so well suited to Qatar. Kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms and villa ground floors all see water at some point, and a board that shrugs it off will outlast laminate in the same room by years.

We supply and lay vinyl, PVC and SPC flooring across Qatar, including the sub-floor preparation that decides whether a clicked floor stays flat. We work across Doha, Al Wakra, Al Khor, Lusail, Al Rayyan and the rest of Qatar.

SPC flooring and barkia, and how they relate to vinyl
SPC is the rigid-core board most of our vinyl floors use. It comes in ten colours, shown below with the skirting that finishes them, and a zigzag laying pattern is available as well.

Barkia is the name most commonly used in Qatar for the click-together plastic flooring sold in wood and stone effects. In practice it is the same family of product as the vinyl and SPC boards above, so if you have been quoted for barkia by one company and vinyl by another, you are usually comparing similar things.

What actually separates a cheap board from a good one is the thickness of the core and the wear layer on top. A thin board over an uneven floor will show every dip and the joints will open up. We quote on the board grade rather than the name it is sold under.
Send us the room. Message us on WhatsApp with photos and rough dimensions and we will tell you which range suits the room and how the existing floor affects the cost.
Free survey. We measure and check the sub-floor for level. On a clicked floor this is the step that decides whether the joints hold.

Installation. We prepare the sub-floor, lay the boards, fit trims and clear the offcuts. Most rooms are finished in a day.
How much does vinyl flooring cost in Qatar?

Vinyl and SPC flooring starts from QAR 75 per sqm, supplied and fitted. The final price depends on the board, the laying pattern and whether the existing floor needs levelling, and we confirm it in a written quote after a free survey.
What is the difference between vinyl, PVC and SPC?

They overlap heavily. PVC is the plastic the boards are made from, vinyl is the general trade name, and SPC is a rigid stone-plastic composite core that makes the board harder and more stable underfoot. Everything we fit is a rigid-core board rather than soft sheet vinyl.

The board itself is. An SPC core will not swell if water sits on it, which is why it works in kitchens and bathrooms where laminate fails. Standing water can still get through the joints to the sub-floor, so a wet room needs sealing at the edges as well.
Can vinyl be laid over existing tiles?

Usually yes, and it saves the cost and mess of removing them. The tiles need to be sound and reasonably flat. Deep grout lines can telegraph through a thin board, so we check at the survey and level them first where needed.
Should I choose vinyl or parquet?

Choose vinyl where water is a factor, or where you want the look at a lower cost. Choose real wood parquet where the room stays dry and you want a genuine timber surface, or laminate for a similar look at a lower cost. We fit both, so we will tell you honestly which suits the room.
How long does vinyl flooring take to install?

A typical room is laid in a day. The variable is preparation, not laying: if the existing floor needs levelling that adds a day and has to cure before boards go down. We confirm this at the survey rather than on the day.
Does vinyl flooring cope with Qatar's heat?

Indoors, yes. In air-conditioned rooms it is very stable. Direct sun through large glazing is the thing to watch, since it can warm a floor unevenly, so we leave the correct expansion gap at the perimeter to allow for movement.

فينيل وPVC وألواح SPC ذات النواة الصلبة المقاومة للماء بمظهر الخشب والحجر، يقيسها ويركّبها فنيونا.

تغيّرت أرضيات الفينيل كثيرًا. فالألواح ذات النواة الصلبة التي نركّبها اليوم تختلف تمامًا عن الفينيل على شكل لفائف الذي لا يزال الاسم يستحضره في الأذهان: فهي تتعشّق فوق الأرضية القائمة، ومقاومة تمامًا للماء، ويصعب تمييز أفضل تصاميمها الخشبية عن الخشب الطبيعي قبل لمسها.

هذه المقاومة للماء هي ما يجعل الفينيل مناسبًا جدًا لقطر. فالمطابخ والحمامات وغرف الغسيل والطوابق الأرضية في الفلل تتعرض جميعها للماء في وقت ما، واللوح الذي لا يتأثر به يدوم سنوات أطول من اللامينيت في الغرفة نفسها.

نورّد ونركّب أرضيات الفينيل وPVC وSPC في جميع أنحاء قطر، بما في ذلك تجهيز الأرضية الأساسية الذي يحدد ما إذا كانت الأرضية المعشّقة ستبقى مستوية. نعمل في الدوحة والوكرة والخور ولوسيل والريان وسائر مناطق قطر.

SPC هو اللوح ذو النواة الصلبة الذي تعتمد عليه معظم أرضيات الفينيل التي نركّبها. ويتوفر بعشرة ألوان معروضة أدناه مع الوزرة التي تكمل تشطيبها، كما يتوفر نمط التركيب المتعرج.

الباركيه هو الاسم الأكثر تداولًا في قطر للأرضيات البلاستيكية المعشّقة التي تُباع بمظهر الخشب والحجر. وهو عمليًا من فئة ألواح الفينيل وSPC المذكورة أعلاه نفسها، فإذا تلقيتم عرضًا للباركيه من شركة وعرضًا للفينيل من أخرى، فأنتم في الغالب تقارنون بين منتجات متشابهة.

ما يميز اللوح الرخيص عن الجيد فعلًا هو سماكة النواة وطبقة مقاومة الاهتراء التي تعلوها. فاللوح الرفيع فوق أرضية غير مستوية يُظهر كل انخفاض، وتتفتح وصلاته. ونحن نسعّر بحسب درجة اللوح لا بحسب الاسم الذي يُباع به.

عرض السعر. عرض سعر مكتوب يشمل التجهيز والألواح والتشطيبات والتركيب، دون رسوم منفصلة للتوصيل أو التركيب.

كم تكلفة أرضيات الفينيل في قطر؟

ما الفرق بين الفينيل وPVC وSPC؟

تتداخل هذه المسميات كثيرًا. فـPVC هو البلاستيك الذي تُصنع منه الألواح، والفينيل هو الاسم التجاري العام، أما SPC فهو نواة صلبة مركّبة من الحجر والبلاستيك تجعل اللوح أقسى وأكثر ثباتًا تحت القدم. وكل ما نركّبه ألواح ذات نواة صلبة وليس فينيلًا لينًا على شكل لفائف.
هل أرضيات الفينيل مقاومة للماء فعلًا؟

اللوح نفسه مقاوم للماء. فنواة SPC لا تنتفخ إذا بقي الماء عليها، ولهذا تنجح في المطابخ والحمامات حيث يفشل اللامينيت. لكن الماء الراكد قد يتسرب عبر الوصلات إلى الأرضية الأساسية، لذا تحتاج الغرف الرطبة إلى إحكام الحواف أيضًا.
هل يمكن تركيب الفينيل فوق البلاط القائم؟

نعم في الغالب، وهذا يوفّر تكلفة إزالته وما يصاحبها من فوضى. ويجب أن يكون البلاط سليمًا ومستويًا إلى حد معقول. وقد تظهر آثار خطوط الترويب العميقة عبر اللوح الرفيع، لذا نفحصها أثناء المعاينة ونسوّيها أولًا عند الحاجة.
هل أختار الفينيل أم الباركيه الخشبي؟

اختاروا الفينيل حيث يكون الماء عاملًا مؤثرًا، أو إذا أردتم المظهر نفسه بتكلفة أقل. واختاروا الباركيه الخشبي الطبيعي حيث تبقى الغرفة جافة وترغبون في سطح خشبي حقيقي، أو اللامينيت لمظهر مشابه بتكلفة أقل. نحن نركّب الاثنين، لذا سنخبركم بصراحة بما يناسب الغرفة.
تُركّب الغرفة المعتادة في يوم واحد. والعامل المتغير هو التجهيز لا التركيب: فإذا احتاجت الأرضية القائمة إلى تسوية، يضاف يوم آخر ويجب أن تجف قبل وضع الألواح. ونؤكد ذلك أثناء المعاينة لا في يوم التنفيذ.
هل تتحمل أرضيات الفينيل حرارة قطر؟

نعم في الأماكن الداخلية، فهي شديدة الثبات في الغرف المكيّفة. وما ينبغي الانتباه إليه هو أشعة الشمس المباشرة عبر الواجهات الزجاجية الكبيرة، إذ قد تسخّن الأرضية بصورة غير متساوية، لذا نترك فاصل التمدد الصحيح عند المحيط لاستيعاب الحركة.

Most of what makes a ceiling look expensive is board work. The coves that hide the lighting, the recess a linear AC diffuser sits in, the dropped bulkhead that defines a seating area: all of it is gypsum board, cut and fixed on site.

It is also the trade where setting out matters most. Ceilings are read from across the room, so a cove that is a few millimetres out of parallel with the wall is visible from the door. We set out to the finished room rather than to the structure above it, which is not always the same line.

We fix gypsum board and cement board across Qatar for villas, apartments, offices and retail, and we coordinate with the electrical and AC trades rather than boarding over their work. We work across Doha, Al Wakra, Al Khor, Lusail, Al Rayyan and the rest of Qatar.

Cement board or gypsum board: which goes where

Gypsum board is the right choice for most indoor ceilings and partitions. It is light, it cuts cleanly, and it takes curves, coves and fine detail well. Its weakness is water, and even the moisture-resistant grade is meant for steam and splashes rather than for getting wet.

Cement board does not soften when it gets wet, so it is what we use where gypsum would fail: outdoor ceilings and soffits, wet areas, and walls that will be tiled. It is heavier and harder to cut than gypsum, so it suits flat runs better than detailed coves.
Send us the space. Message us on WhatsApp with photos and, if you have them, the lighting and AC layouts. Those drive the ceiling design more than anything else.
Free survey. We visit, check the slab height and existing services, and confirm what drop is realistic once ducting and pipework are allowed for.
Setting out. We agree the cove lines, bulkhead positions and diffuser recesses on site before any framing goes up, because these cannot be moved afterwards.
Fixing and finishing. We frame, board, form the openings, then tape and fill ready for the painter, and clear the site.

It is the on-site fixing of board to a metal or timber frame. In Qatar people use the name for two different materials: gypsum board for indoor ceilings, partitions and coves, and cement board for outdoor and wet areas. We fix both, so tell us where the board is going and we will confirm which one the job needs.
How much ceiling height will a false ceiling take?

It depends on what has to pass above it. A plain flat ceiling can drop as little as 10 centimetres, but a run of AC ducting or a linear diffuser recess needs considerably more. We confirm the realistic drop at the survey rather than promising a figure first.
Can you build the ceiling around the AC and lighting?

That is the normal way we work. We set out the diffuser recesses and light positions before framing, and coordinate with the AC and electrical trades so nothing is boarded over. Retrofitting an opening after the ceiling is finished is far more disruptive.
Which board should be used in a kitchen or bathroom?

Moisture-resistant board in any room that sees steam or splashing, and standard board elsewhere. The cost difference is small next to the cost of taking a ceiling down again, so we specify moisture-resistant wherever there is any doubt. Where board will get wet or be tiled, such as shower walls, we use cement board instead.
Do you finish ready for painting?
Yes. We tape, joint and fill so the surface is ready for the painter to prime. We do not paint, but we hand over at a standard where the painter is not fixing our work before they start.
How long does a false ceiling take?

A single room is usually framed and boarded within a few days, with jointing and filling after that. Whole-villa ceilings run to a few weeks and are sequenced room by room so other trades can keep working alongside us.

معظم ما يمنح السقف مظهرًا فاخرًا هو أعمال الألواح. فالكرانيش التي تخفي الإضاءة، والتجويف الذي يستقر فيه مخرج التكييف الطولي، والجسر المنخفض الذي يحدد منطقة الجلوس: كلها من ألواح الجبس التي تُقص وتُثبَّت في الموقع.

وهي أيضًا الحرفة التي تكتسب فيها دقة التخطيط أهمية قصوى. فالأسقف تُرى من طرف الغرفة الآخر، لذا فإن الكرنيش الذي ينحرف بضعة مليمترات عن موازاة الجدار يظهر من عند الباب. ونحن نخطط وفق الغرفة بعد تشطيبها لا وفق الهيكل الذي فوقها، وليس الخطان متطابقين دائمًا.

نركّب ألواح الجبس (جبس بورد) وألواح الأسمنت في جميع أنحاء قطر للفلل والشقق والمكاتب والمحلات، وننسق مع فنيي الكهرباء والتكييف بدلًا من تغطية أعمالهم بالألواح. نعمل في الدوحة والوكرة والخور ولوسيل والريان وسائر مناطق قطر.

جبس (عادي، مقاوم للرطوبة، مقاوم للحريق) وألواح الأسمنت
الجبس: معالجة بالشريط والمعجون، جاهز للدهان
ألواح الأسمنت أم ألواح الجبس: أيهما يناسب كل مكان

ألواح الجبس هي الخيار المناسب لمعظم الأسقف والقواطع الداخلية. فهي خفيفة وتُقص بسهولة، وتتشكل جيدًا في المنحنيات والكرانيش والتفاصيل الدقيقة. أما نقطة ضعفها فهي الماء، وحتى الفئة المقاومة للرطوبة مخصصة للبخار والرذاذ لا للبلل المباشر.

ألواح الأسمنت لا تلين إذا تعرضت للماء، ولذلك نستخدمها حيث تفشل ألواح الجبس: الأسقف الخارجية وأسفل البروزات، والمناطق الرطبة، والجدران التي ستُكسى بالبلاط. وهي أثقل من الجبس وأصعب في القص، لذا تناسب المساحات المستوية أكثر من الكرانيش كثيرة التفاصيل.
المطابخ والغرف التي يكثر فيها البخار
أرسلوا لنا تفاصيل المكان. راسلونا عبر الواتساب بالصور، ومخططات الإضاءة والتكييف إن توفرت لديكم، فهي التي توجّه تصميم السقف أكثر من أي شيء آخر.
معاينة مجانية. نزور الموقع ونفحص ارتفاع البلاطة والتمديدات القائمة، ونؤكد مقدار النزول الواقعي للسقف بعد احتساب مجاري الهواء والمواسير.
التخطيط. نتفق في الموقع على خطوط الكرانيش ومواضع الجسور وتجاويف مخارج التكييف قبل تركيب أي هيكل، لأنها لا يمكن تغييرها بعد ذلك.
التركيب والتشطيب. نركّب الهيكل والألواح ونشكّل الفتحات، ثم نعالج الوصلات بالشريط والمعجون لتكون جاهزة للدهّان، وننظف الموقع.

هو تثبيت الألواح في الموقع على هيكل معدني أو خشبي. ويُستخدم هذا الاسم في قطر لمادتين مختلفتين: ألواح الجبس للأسقف والقواطع والكرانيش الداخلية، وألواح الأسمنت للمناطق الخارجية والرطبة. ونحن نركّب النوعين، فأخبرونا بمكان الألواح وسنؤكد النوع الذي يحتاج إليه العمل.
كم يأخذ السقف المستعار من ارتفاع الغرفة؟

يعتمد ذلك على ما سيمر فوقه. فقد لا يتجاوز نزول السقف المسطح البسيط 10 سنتيمترات، لكن مسار مجرى هواء التكييف أو تجويف مخرج التكييف الطولي يحتاج إلى أكثر من ذلك بكثير. ونؤكد مقدار النزول الواقعي أثناء المعاينة بدلًا من الوعد برقم مسبقًا.
هل يمكنكم بناء السقف حول التكييف والإضاءة؟

هذه هي طريقة عملنا المعتادة. نخطط تجاويف مخارج التكييف ومواضع الإضاءة قبل تركيب الهيكل، وننسق مع فنيي التكييف والكهرباء حتى لا يُغطى شيء بالألواح. أما فتح فتحة بعد اكتمال السقف فهو أكثر إزعاجًا بكثير.
ما الألواح التي ينبغي استخدامها في المطبخ أو الحمام؟

ألواح مقاومة للرطوبة في أي غرفة تتعرض للبخار أو الرذاذ، وألواح عادية في غيرها. وفرق التكلفة بسيط مقارنة بتكلفة إنزال السقف من جديد، لذا نعتمد الألواح المقاومة للرطوبة حيثما وُجد أي شك. وحيث تتعرض الألواح للبلل أو تُكسى بالبلاط، مثل جدران الدش، نستخدم ألواح الأسمنت.
نعم. نعالج الوصلات بالشريط والمعجون ليصبح السطح جاهزًا لطبقة الأساس من الدهّان. ونحن لا نقوم بالدهان، لكننا نسلّم العمل بمستوى لا يضطر معه الدهّان إلى إصلاح عملنا قبل أن يبدأ.

عادة ما يُركَّب هيكل الغرفة الواحدة وألواحها في غضون أيام قليلة، تليها معالجة الوصلات والمعجون. أما أسقف الفيلا كاملة فتستغرق بضعة أسابيع، وتُنفَّذ غرفة بعد غرفة ليتمكن الفنيون الآخرون من مواصلة عملهم إلى جانبنا.

main: Sofa Making in Qatar: From QAR 850 per piece. Al Arabia Carpets in Doha offers a free site survey and quotation.
Sofas and majlis seating built to your room's real dimensions, in the fabric and firmness you choose.
Get a free quote on WhatsApp

Standard sofas are made for standard rooms, and very few rooms in Qatar are standard. Majlis seating in particular runs along the walls, so shop-bought pieces leave awkward gaps at the corners and stop short of the ends, wasting the floor area the room was designed around.

Making the seating instead of buying it fixes that, and it costs less than people expect. You choose the dimensions, the fabric, the frame and how firm the seat is, and the finished pieces follow the walls exactly.

We make majlis seating, sofas, corner units and daybeds for homes, offices and majlis across Qatar, and we reupholster existing frames that are still sound. We work across Doha, Al Wakra, Al Khor, Lusail, Al Rayyan and the rest of Qatar.

Send us the room. Message us on WhatsApp with photos and rough wall lengths, and tell us how many people the seating needs to take.
Free measurement. We visit, measure each wall and bring fabric samples so you can see and feel them in the room's own light rather than in a showroom.
Quotation. A written quote covering frames, foam, fabric and delivery, with the dimensions of each piece confirmed before anything is cut.
Making and delivery. We build in our workshop, then deliver and position the pieces. Typical lead times run to a few weeks depending on the fabric.
How much does a custom sofa cost in Qatar?

Custom sofas and majlis seating start from QAR 850 per piece. The final price depends on the size of each piece, the fabric and the frame, and we confirm it in a written quote after measuring the room for free.
Is a custom sofa more expensive than buying one?

Not as much as people assume, and for majlis seating it is often cheaper than buying enough standard pieces to fill the same walls. You are paying for materials and labour rather than for a showroom and shipping, and nothing is wasted on gaps that do not fit.
How long does a made-to-measure sofa take?

Usually a few weeks from the confirmed order, and the fabric is normally what sets the pace rather than the frame. If a fabric has to be ordered in, we tell you that at quotation stage instead of after you have committed.
Can I choose how firm the seats are?

Yes, and it is worth taking time over. Majlis seating that people sit on for hours generally wants a firmer foam than a living room sofa people sink into. We bring samples of different densities so you decide by sitting on them, not from a description.
Can you reupholster my existing sofa?

If the frame is sound, yes, and it usually costs less than replacing it. We check the frame and springs first: where the frame itself has gone, reupholstering it is money spent on something that will fail again, and we will say so.
What is the difference between floor-level and raised majlis?

Floor-level seating sits directly on the floor, seats more people along the same wall and is closer to the traditional arrangement. A raised majlis sits at normal sofa height and is easier for older guests to get in and out of. We make both.
Do you take the old seating away?
Yes, if you want it removed. We can take the old pieces on the delivery run so you are not left with them, or leave them if you are keeping or passing them on. Tell us which at the measuring visit.

وتفصيل الجلسات بدلًا من شرائها يحل هذه المشكلة، وتكلفته أقل مما يتوقعه الناس. فأنتم تختارون الأبعاد والقماش والهيكل ودرجة صلابة المقعد، وتأتي القطع النهائية مطابقة للجدران تمامًا.

أرسلوا لنا تفاصيل الغرفة. راسلونا عبر الواتساب بالصور وأطوال الجدران التقريبية، وأخبرونا بعدد الأشخاص الذين يجب أن تتسع لهم الجلسة.

عرض السعر. عرض سعر مكتوب يشمل الهياكل والإسفنج والقماش والتوصيل، مع تأكيد أبعاد كل قطعة قبل قص أي شيء.
الصناعة والتوصيل. نصنع القطع في ورشتنا، ثم نوصلها ونضعها في مكانها. وتمتد مدد التسليم المعتادة إلى بضعة أسابيع بحسب القماش.
كم تكلفة تفصيل الكنب في قطر؟
يبدأ سعر الكنب وجلسات المجالس حسب الطلب من 850 ريالًا للقطعة. ويعتمد السعر النهائي على مقاس كل قطعة والقماش والهيكل، ونؤكده في عرض سعر مكتوب بعد قياس الغرفة مجانًا.
هل تفصيل الكنب أغلى من شرائه جاهزًا؟

ليس بالقدر الذي يظنه الناس، وفي جلسات المجالس غالبًا ما يكون أرخص من شراء قطع جاهزة كافية لتغطية الجدران نفسها. فأنتم تدفعون مقابل المواد والعمل لا مقابل صالة عرض وشحن، ولا يضيع شيء في فراغات غير ملائمة.
كم يستغرق تفصيل الكنب حسب المقاس؟
عادة بضعة أسابيع من تأكيد الطلب، والقماش هو الذي يحدد الوتيرة في الغالب لا الهيكل. وإذا كان لا بد من طلب القماش، فسنخبركم بذلك عند عرض السعر لا بعد أن تلتزموا.
هل يمكنني اختيار درجة صلابة المقاعد؟

نعم، ويستحق الأمر التمهل فيه. فجلسات المجالس التي يجلس عليها الناس ساعات طويلة تتطلب عمومًا إسفنجًا أكثر صلابة من كنب غرفة المعيشة الذي يغوص فيه الجالس. ونحضر عينات بكثافات مختلفة لتقرروا بالجلوس عليها لا من مجرد وصف.
هل يمكنكم إعادة تنجيد الكنب الذي لدي؟
إذا كان الهيكل سليمًا فنعم، وعادة ما تكون تكلفة ذلك أقل من الاستبدال. ونفحص الهيكل والنوابض أولًا: فإذا كان الهيكل نفسه قد تلف، فإن إعادة تنجيده إنفاق على شيء سيتلف مجددًا، وسنخبركم بذلك.
ما الفرق بين المجلس الأرضي والمجلس المرتفع؟

A sofa usually wears out from the outside in. The fabric fades and frays, the seat foam loses its shape, and the piece starts to look tired, while the frame underneath is still perfectly sound. When that is the case, reupholstering usually costs less than replacing it, and you keep a piece that already fits the room.

The frame decides whether it is worth doing. Before we quote we check the frame, the springs and the joints. If the frame has failed, we will tell you, because new fabric on a broken frame is money spent on something that will fail again.

Is it cheaper to reupholster a sofa or buy a new one?

If the frame is sound, reupholstering usually costs less than replacing a sofa of the same quality, and it keeps a piece that already fits your room. If the frame has failed, a new sofa is normally the better spend, and we will say so.
How much does sofa upholstery cost in Qatar?
It depends on the size of the piece, how much fabric it takes and whether the foam or frame needs work, so we quote after checking it. The check and the written quotation are free.
Yes, both floor-level and raised majlis. Majlis seating is often the best candidate, because the pieces are built for the room and a replacement set would have to be made to measure anyway.
Can you repair a sagging sofa?

Usually, yes. Sagging normally comes from tired foam or from springs that have given way, and both can be replaced. If the frame itself has cracked, we check whether it can be repaired before quoting.
Can you only replace the foam?

Yes. If the fabric still looks good but the seats have lost their shape, new foam on its own brings most of the comfort back. We can bring samples of different densities so you choose the firmness by sitting on them.
Can I use the same frame and change the style?

To a degree. New fabric, new cushions and a change of firmness can change how a sofa looks and feels, but the basic shape stays the same as the frame. For a different shape, a made-to-measure piece is usually the better route.

أيهما أوفر: إعادة تنجيد الكنب أم شراء كنب جديد؟

كم تكلفة تنجيد الكنب في قطر؟

نعم، المجالس الأرضية والمرتفعة على حد سواء. وكثيرًا ما تكون جلسات المجالس أنسب ما يُعاد تنجيده، لأن قطعها صُنعت للغرفة، وأي بديل لها سيحتاج إلى تفصيل حسب المقاس في كل الأحوال.

نعم. فإذا كان القماش لا يزال بحالة جيدة لكن المقاعد فقدت شكلها، فإن الإسفنج الجديد وحده يعيد معظم الراحة. ويمكننا إحضار عينات بكثافات مختلفة لتختاروا درجة الصلابة بالجلوس عليها.

إلى حد ما. فالقماش الجديد والوسائد الجديدة وتغيير درجة الصلابة تغيّر مظهر الكنب وإحساسه، لكن الشكل الأساسي يبقى كما هو في الهيكل. وللحصول على شكل مختلف، يكون تفصيل قطعة حسب المقاس هو الخيار الأنسب عادة.

main: Al Arabia Carpets provides Cabinets in Doha and across Qatar, with a free site survey and quotation.
Kitchen, bedroom and living room cabinetry built to your room's real dimensions rather than to standard sizes.
Get a free quote on WhatsApp

Almost every cabinet problem in a Qatari home comes from the same place: standard carcasses fitted into a room that is not a standard size. You end up with a filler panel at one end, a gap above the units collecting dust, and storage that stops well short of the ceiling.

Making cabinets to the room instead removes all three. The run reaches wall to wall, the units go to full height, and the interior is planned around what is actually being stored rather than around what a catalogue offers.

We design, build and install cabinetry across Qatar for kitchens, bedrooms, living rooms and offices. Whichever room you are starting with, the process below is the same. We work across Doha, Al Wakra, Al Khor, Lusail, Al Rayyan and the rest of Qatar.

Your room's measured height and width
Tell us the room. Message us on WhatsApp with photos and rough dimensions, and say what needs to go inside. Storage contents shape the design more than the elevation does.
Free measurement. We measure the room properly, including how far out of square the walls run, which is what decides whether a run fits wall to wall.
Design and quotation. We propose a layout with finishes you can see samples of, then quote in writing with the interior fit-out itemised.
Manufacture and installation. Built in our workshop, then delivered and installed. Most rooms are fitted within a day or two once manufacture is complete.
What is the difference between fitted and freestanding cabinets?

Fitted cabinetry is built into the room and scribed to the walls, so it reaches full height and leaves no gaps. Freestanding units can be taken with you when you move but lose the space above and beside them. In most Qatari villas, fitted storage gains a substantial amount of usable volume.
How long do custom cabinets take?

Usually a few weeks from confirmed design to installation, with manufacture accounting for most of that. The fitting itself is quick: most single rooms are installed within a day or two, so disruption at home is short.
Can cabinets be built to the ceiling?

Yes, and we would normally recommend it. The gap above standard-height units is wasted storage and collects dust. Building to the ceiling adds a full extra shelf for the items you reach for once or twice a year.
Do you handle the room's walls being out of square?

Yes, and it is the main reason to measure rather than order standard sizes. We scribe the end panels to the wall so the run finishes tight against it. Standard carcasses cannot do this, which is why they need filler strips.
Which finishes work best in Qatar's humidity?

Moisture-resistant board with a good edge seal is the important part, more than the visible finish. In kitchens and bathrooms we specify moisture-resistant carcasses as standard, because it is the exposed board edges rather than the door faces that fail first.
Do you make kitchen and bedroom cabinets as well?

Yes, both, and they are covered in more detail on their own pages. This page is the overview; see our kitchen cabinets page for kitchens specifically, and our wardrobes page for bedroom and room cabinets.

main: تقدم سجاد العربية خدمة الخزائن في الدوحة وجميع أنحاء قطر، مع معاينة وعرض سعر مجاني.
خزائن للمطابخ وغرف النوم وغرف المعيشة تُصنع وفق الأبعاد الحقيقية لغرفتكم لا وفق المقاسات المعتادة.
اطلب عرض سعر مجاني على الواتساب

تنبع معظم مشكلات الخزائن في البيوت القطرية من مصدر واحد: هياكل بمقاسات معتادة تُركّب في غرفة ليست بمقاس معتاد. فينتهي الأمر بلوح حشو عند أحد الطرفين، وفراغ فوق الوحدات يجمع الغبار، ومساحة تخزين تتوقف قبل السقف بمسافة كبيرة.
وتفصيل الخزائن وفق الغرفة يزيل هذه المشكلات الثلاث. فالصف يمتد من الجدار إلى الجدار، والوحدات تصل إلى الارتفاع الكامل، ويُخطَّط الداخل وفق ما سيُخزَّن فعلًا لا وفق ما يقدمه الكتالوج.

نصمم الخزائن ونصنعها ونركّبها في جميع أنحاء قطر للمطابخ وغرف النوم وغرف المعيشة والمكاتب. وأيًا كانت الغرفة التي تبدؤون بها، فالخطوات أدناه واحدة. نعمل في الدوحة والوكرة والخور ولوسيل والريان وسائر مناطق قطر.

التصنيع والتركيب. تُصنع في ورشتنا ثم تُوصل وتُركّب. وتُركّب معظم الغرف في غضون يوم أو يومين بعد اكتمال التصنيع.
ما الفرق بين الخزائن المدمجة والخزائن المنفصلة؟

تُبنى الخزائن المدمجة داخل الغرفة وتُقص لتطابق الجدران، فتصل إلى الارتفاع الكامل ولا تترك فراغات. أما الوحدات المنفصلة فيمكنكم أخذها عند الانتقال، لكنها تُفقدكم المساحة فوقها وبجانبها. وفي معظم الفلل القطرية، يضيف التخزين المدمج حجمًا كبيرًا قابلًا للاستخدام.
كم يستغرق تفصيل الخزائن حسب الطلب؟
عادة بضعة أسابيع من تأكيد التصميم إلى التركيب، ويستأثر التصنيع بمعظم هذه المدة. أما التركيب نفسه فسريع: إذ تُركّب معظم الغرف الواحدة في غضون يوم أو يومين، فيكون الإزعاج في المنزل قصيرًا.
هل يمكن بناء الخزائن حتى السقف؟
نعم، وهذا ما نوصي به عادة. فالفراغ فوق الوحدات ذات الارتفاع المعتاد مساحة تخزين مهدرة ويجمع الغبار. والبناء حتى السقف يضيف رفًا كاملًا إضافيًا للأغراض التي تحتاجون إليها مرة أو مرتين في السنة.
هل تتعاملون مع الجدران المنحرفة عن الزاوية القائمة؟

نعم، وهذا هو السبب الرئيسي للقياس بدلًا من طلب المقاسات المعتادة. فنقص الألواح الطرفية لتطابق الجدار حتى ينتهي الصف ملاصقًا له تمامًا. ولا يمكن تحقيق ذلك بالهياكل ذات المقاسات المعتادة، ولهذا تحتاج إلى شرائح حشو.

الأهم هو ألواح مقاومة للرطوبة بحواف محكمة الإغلاق، أكثر من التشطيب الظاهر. وفي المطابخ والحمامات نعتمد الهياكل المقاومة للرطوبة بصفة أساسية، لأن حواف الألواح المكشوفة هي التي تتلف أولًا لا أوجه الأبواب.
هل تصنعون خزائن المطابخ وغرف النوم أيضًا؟
نعم، كلاهما، ولكل منهما تفاصيل أوفى في صفحته الخاصة. فهذه الصفحة نظرة عامة؛ اطّلعوا على صفحة خزائن المطابخ لكل ما يخص المطابخ، وصفحة خزائن الملابس لخزائن غرف النوم والغرف.

ما يجب تحديده قبل بدء العمل، ولماذا يهم ترتيب مراحل التنفيذ أكثر من أي اختيار منفرد، وما ينبغي أن يغطيه عرض السعر.

كيف تخطط جلسات مجلس تناسب الغرفة، وتختار بين الجلسة الأرضية والمرتفعة، وتنسق بين القماش والإضاءة والأرضيات.

Where can I find ceramic tile suppliers in Qatar?

What should I look for in a tile supplier?

Ask to see the tile in person rather than choosing from a photo, get a written quote that states the area it covers, and check that extra tiles from the same batch are available, because colour can vary between batches. A supplier who asks about the room before recommending a tile is a good sign.

Choose a floor tile with a slip-resistant surface, since polished tile gets slippery when wet. Mosaic works well on bathroom walls and curved areas because the small pieces follow the shape of the surface.
What is mosaic tile best used for?
Mosaic is most often used for feature walls, bathroom walls, kitchen backsplashes and small areas where a pattern makes more impact than a plain tile.

Artificial green and flower walls for interiors, backdrops and event styling.

This is greenery for walls, not for floors. Foliage and flower panels build up into a vertical surface used behind reception desks, as a feature wall in a majlis or café, and as a photo backdrop for events — the look of a planted wall with none of the irrigation, drainage or light a living one demands.

Panels are built up on site so the coverage reads as continuous rather than tiled, and flower clusters are distributed by hand. Mixing tones matters: a single flat green over a large area is the thing that makes an artificial wall look artificial.
Panels blended on site, seams disguised
How is a green wall different from artificial grass?

Different product and different job. Grass is a floor covering laid flat for gardens and terraces; a green wall is foliage and flower panels built up vertically as decoration. For lawns and terraces see our artificial grass carpet instead.
Does an artificial green wall look fake?

It does if it is a single flat green tiled across the wall. We mix foliage tones and distribute flower clusters by hand, and disguise the panel seams during build-up, which is what stops it reading as a repeating pattern.
Dust it occasionally — a soft brush or a vacuum on low suction. There is no watering, feeding or light requirement, which is the whole reason to choose it over a living wall indoors.

Premium wall-to-wall carpet for bedrooms and majlis, with denser pile and better recovery.

What you pay for in a premium carpet is density and recovery. More fibre packed into the same area means footprints and furniture dents lift out instead of setting in, and the surface still looks even after a year of use rather than showing tracks through the doorways.
It is worth the money in rooms where you notice underfoot comfort — bedrooms and majlis — and much less so in a hallway, where a hard-wearing mid-range carpet does the same job for less.
What actually makes one carpet better than another?

Density more than anything. Press your thumb in — if you feel the backing easily, the pile is sparse and it will flatten along traffic routes. A dense pile springs back and keeps an even appearance far longer.
Where is a luxury carpet worth it?

Bedrooms and majlis, where you are barefoot and notice the difference underfoot. In a hallway the traffic is the dominant factor, so a hard-wearing mid-range carpet is usually the more sensible spend.
For a wall-to-wall carpet, yes. It adds comfort, absorbs sound and — the part people underestimate — protects the pile from below, which measurably extends how long the carpet keeps its appearance.

Mosque carpet installation: qiblah alignment, row setting out and phased fitting.

Fitting a prayer hall is a setting-out job before it is a carpet job. The saff rows have to run true to the qiblah, not to the walls — and in most buildings those are not the same line. Get the first row wrong and the error is repeated and magnified across every row behind it.

We establish the qiblah on site, set the first row from it, and work outward. The second constraint is time: a prayer hall stays in use, so we phase the work around prayer times and hand back sections progressively rather than closing the hall.
First row established from the qiblah
Section by section, hall stays usable
How do you align prayer rows to the qiblah?

We establish the qiblah direction on site and set the first row from it, then work outward. Rows are aligned to that line rather than to the walls, because in most buildings the two differ and aligning to the wall puts every row slightly off.
Does the mosque have to close during installation?
No. We phase the work around prayer times and hand back sections as they are completed, so the hall stays usable throughout. Larger halls are scheduled over several days on that basis.
Do you remove the old carpet?
Yes, lifting and disposing of the existing carpet is included. We also check the sub-floor once it is exposed and flag anything that needs attention before the new carpet goes down.

Artificial grass gives you a green surface all year round without irrigation, mowing or fertiliser, which makes it well suited to Qatar's climate. We supply and lay it across Qatar on villa gardens, roof terraces, balconies, majlis surrounds, play areas, entrance steps and around pools. The current generation looks far more convincing than the flat plastic turf people remember, because the blades are cut to different lengths and mixed with a brown thatch at the base. Our grass is UV-stabilised so it holds its colour under strong sun.

The part that decides whether it still looks good in three years is underneath it. Grass laid straight onto sand moves and dips; grass laid over a properly compacted, free-draining base stays flat and lets rain and hose water pass through rather than pooling.

How long does artificial grass last in Qatar?

A UV-stabilised grass over a properly built base holds its colour and shape for many years of Gulf sun. What shortens that life is almost always the base rather than the grass: poor compaction shows as dips and ripples long before the fibres wear out.
Does artificial grass get hot in the sun?

It does warm up in direct sun, like any surface. A lighter grass with a shorter pile runs cooler, shaded areas stay comfortable, and rinsing it down brings the temperature straight back. For play areas in full sun we will talk through pile and colour with you.
How does the water drain away?

The backing is perforated and sits on a compacted free-draining base, so rain and hose water pass through and away rather than pooling on top. On roof terraces and balconies we set the falls to the existing outlets, which is the part that needs surveying properly.
Is artificial grass safe for children and pets?

Yes. The grass is non-toxic and drains freely, so it does not hold water. For play areas we can lay a shock-absorbing layer under the grass, and pet waste rinses off the surface rather than soaking in as it would with a real lawn.
Does artificial grass fade in Qatar's sun?
Our artificial grass is UV-stabilised specifically for Gulf conditions, so it holds its colour far longer than non-stabilised alternatives. We can show you samples that have been in service outdoors.
How do you maintain artificial grass?
Rinse it with a hose from time to time and brush the pile upright in high-traffic spots. There is no mowing, watering or fertilising.
Can artificial grass be laid on a roof terrace or balcony?
Yes. It is a common installation in Doha. We fit it over a free-draining base so water passes through to the existing drainage.

main: Al Arabia Carpets supplies and installs Cabinet and Gypsum Board Work in Doha and across Qatar, with free delivery and installation.
Built-in joinery integrated with gypsum work, so cabinetry and ceilings finish as one.

This is the work that sits between carpentry and gypsum: storage that is built into the wall rather than placed against it. Cabinets finish flush with the plasterwork, niches line through with the shelving beside them, and the join between joinery and wall disappears.

Doing both trades together is the whole point. When cabinetry and gypsum are quoted by separate contractors the tolerances rarely meet, and you end up with a shadow gap nobody planned. We set out the joinery and the boarding from the same drawing.
Joinery and gypsum set out together
Why combine cabinetry with gypsum work?

Because the junction between them is where the finish is won or lost. Set out from one drawing by one team, the cabinet face lines through with the wall. Split between two contractors, the tolerances almost never meet and a gap appears.
Can you build storage into an existing wall?
Usually yes. We check what is behind the wall first for services and structure, then form the recess and build the joinery into it. Depth is the limiting factor, and we confirm it during the survey.
Do you make lit display niches?
Yes. Niches with concealed LED are a common request in a majlis. The wiring has to be run before the boards close, so it is decided at design stage rather than added later.

A recessed channel around the perimeter of the ceiling that hides an LED strip. The light washes upward and reflects back down, giving soft indirect illumination with no visible fitting. It is the most common gypsum detail we install.
How much ceiling height does a false ceiling take?

Typically 10 to 20 centimetres depending on the detail and what services run above it. We measure the existing height first, because in a room that is already low a shallower design or a partial drop is usually the better call.
We hand it over taped, jointed and ready to paint as standard. Painting can be included in the quote if you would like it finished as one job.

Decorative interior wall panelling — slatted, fluted and upholstered feature walls.

Panelling changes a wall's texture rather than just its colour. Vertical slats and fluted profiles catch light down their length and throw fine shadow lines, so the surface reads differently through the day in a way paint or wallpaper never does.
It is most often used on one wall — behind a TV, behind the head of a bed, or along the run a majlis faces. Panelling every wall in a room usually overwhelms it, and we will say so before quoting.
TV walls, bedheads, majlis feature walls
Texture and shadow line, not just colour
Should I panel the whole room?

Rarely. Panelling works by contrast — one textured wall against three plain ones. Wrap a room in it and the effect cancels out and the space closes in. A single feature wall is almost always the stronger result.
What is the difference between slatted and fluted panelling?

Slatted uses separate battens with a visible gap between them, usually over a dark backing, which gives a strong striped rhythm. Fluted is a continuous surface with rounded grooves, so the effect is softer and more subtle.

Slatted panelling over an acoustic backing does take the edge off echo in a hard-surfaced room. It is not soundproofing, but in a majlis with tiled floors and bare walls the difference in liveliness is noticeable.

A TV wall is the piece of joinery a living room is arranged around, so it is worth building rather than buying. Built in, the screen sits at the right height for your seating, the cabling disappears into the wall, and the boxes and consoles get a ventilated home instead of a shelf of visible clutter.

We design the unit around your actual equipment — screen size, what needs to be reachable by remote, what needs airflow — and integrate lighting behind the screen where you want it. Backlighting a TV wall genuinely reduces eye strain in a dark room.
Ventilated housing for boxes and consoles
Can you hide the cables completely?

Yes. Power and HDMI run inside the unit and through the wall to the equipment housing, so nothing is visible. We need to know the screen position and the socket locations at design stage, because retrofitting it means opening the wall again.
How high should the TV be mounted?

So the centre of the screen sits roughly at eye level when you are seated. That is usually lower than people expect, and lower than a unit designed without reference to the actual seating. We set it from where your majlis or sofa will be.
Do the equipment boxes need ventilation?
They do. A receiver or console in a sealed cabinet runs hot and its life suffers. We build in ventilation and leave rear access, which also makes the eventual cable change far less painful.

Near-white SPC with a clean matt finish. Built for retail, showrooms and ultra-modern interiors.

Al Wakra White is the most extreme light decor in the range — closer to a painted floor than a wood one. It is specified mostly for commercial work: showrooms, clinics, salons and retail units where the floor needs to disappear so that product or merchandising carries the whole visual weight.

In a domestic setting it is a bold, high-maintenance choice. We fit it in homes occasionally, almost always in a room with a specific purpose — a home office, a dressing room — rather than as a whole-house floor.
Single rooms rather than whole house
Is a white floor practical at home?

In a specific room, yes; across a whole house it is demanding. Dark marks and scuffs read immediately against near-white. We normally suggest it for a dressing room or home office rather than hallways and family areas.
Why is white common in showrooms?

Because the floor is meant to vanish. A near-white matt surface throws light back onto whatever is being displayed and adds no colour of its own, which is exactly what retail and clinical spaces want.
Does it scratch more easily than darker decors?
No — the wear layer is the same. Scratches and scuffs are simply more visible against a very pale surface, so the floor looks worn sooner even though it is wearing at the same rate.

Very dark espresso SPC. High contrast and dramatic, with honest trade-offs on dust.
Espresso is the darkest decor we stock and the most dramatic. Against pale walls and light furniture it produces the sort of contrast that photographs extremely well and gives a room real definition.

We will always raise one thing before you commit: in Qatar, fine dust is pale, and it is visible on a dark floor within a day of cleaning. Plenty of clients choose it anyway and are happy — but you should choose it knowing that, not discover it afterwards.
Does a dark floor show dust in Qatar?

Yes, noticeably. Airborne dust here is pale and settles visibly on a dark surface, often within a day. It cleans off easily, but you will see it between cleans in a way you would not on a mid or light floor.
Should I use espresso in a small room?
Usually not. A very dark floor absorbs light and pulls the boundaries of a room inward, so a small or dim space can feel closed in. It is at its best in larger rooms with good natural light.
How do I make a dark floor work?

Keep the walls and larger furniture pale so the contrast is deliberate, use layered lighting rather than one ceiling fitting, and accept a slightly more frequent cleaning routine. Done that way it is the most striking floor we fit.

Mid-tone walnut SPC. The most forgiving decor in the range for busy family homes.

If you want the floor you will think about least, this is it. Mid-tone walnut sits between the two extremes that cause complaints: pale floors that show every dark mark, and dark floors that show every speck of pale dust.

That makes it our standard recommendation for hallways, family rooms and any home with children or frequent guests. It is not the most striking decor we sell, and that is precisely why it keeps looking good between cleans.
Which SPC decor is easiest to keep looking clean?

This one. Pale floors hide dust but show dark marks; dark floors do the reverse. A mid-tone walnut is the only part of the range that is forgiving in both directions, which is why we fit so much of it in hallways.

It is the safe one, and in a hallway or family room that is the right trade. If you want the floor to be a feature, look at Mahogany or the Herringbone; if you want it to disappear and stay tidy, choose this.
Does it suit both traditional and modern rooms?
Yes, more than any other decor here. Mid walnut is neutral enough to sit with traditional majlis seating and with contemporary furniture, which is useful if the house mixes both.

It is a rigid core board, so it resists denting under point loads better than a flexible vinyl. That matters in rooms carrying heavy furniture: majlis seating, dining tables, wardrobes and appliances all sit on small feet that concentrate a lot of weight.
What does a rigid core actually change?

It resists denting. A flexible vinyl can take a permanent mark from a heavy item on a small foot; a rigid core spreads that load. If you are putting wardrobes, a dining table or a full majlis onto the floor, it is the more forgiving choice.
Is grey flooring still a good choice?

Does a cool grey floor make a room feel cold?
It can if the room has little natural light and no warm textures. We usually pair it with a rug and warmer upholstery, which keeps the crispness without the room feeling stark.

Pearl grey SPC in a herringbone pattern. The only format-led floor in the range.

Every other decor in this range is chosen on colour. This one is chosen on pattern. Herringbone lays short planks at right angles into a zig-zag, and the result is a floor that carries a room on its own — which is why it turns up most often in entrance halls, dining rooms and formal majlis.
The pearl grey is deliberately restrained. A strongly coloured herringbone quickly becomes overwhelming across a large area, so a quiet tone lets the pattern do the work without the floor shouting.
Does herringbone cost more to install?

Yes. Each short plank is set individually at an angle and the pattern has to stay true across the whole room, so it takes considerably longer than a straight lay and generates more offcuts. We quote herringbone separately for that reason.
Does herringbone suit a small room?

It can work well in a small entrance hall, where the pattern becomes a feature you see all at once. In a small living room it tends to be too busy — the pattern needs either a contained space or a large one to look deliberate.

Usually pointing along the main sightline as you enter, which draws the eye through the space. We set the direction on site with you before laying, because it is not something that can be changed afterwards.

Does a light floor make a room look bigger?

It genuinely helps. A pale floor reflects daylight back up into the room instead of absorbing it, so the boundaries of the space read as further away. In a small majlis or an apartment living room the difference is easy to see.

No, and that is the main reason we suggest it. The warm undertone sits with cream and beige upholstery rather than pulling grey against it, which is what a cooler light oak tends to do.

Deep red-brown mahogany SPC. A formal floor for majlis and reception rooms.

Mahogany is a formal decor, and we fit it almost entirely in rooms meant to receive guests: the main majlis, a reception room, an office where clients are met. The deep red-brown carries a sense of weight that a pale oak simply does not.

It works best where there is enough natural light or good layered lighting to bring out the red in the grain. In a dim room the same decor flattens towards plain brown, so we will usually walk through the lighting with you before recommending it.
Needs good light to show the red
Is mahogany too formal for a family room?

It can be. The depth of colour that makes it right for a guest majlis reads as heavy in a room used casually every day. For family areas we would usually point you at a mid-tone walnut or an oak instead.

It benefits from it. The red in the grain only shows under decent natural or layered light; under a single dim ceiling fitting the floor flattens towards a plain dark brown and you lose what you paid for.
What furniture suits a mahogany floor?
Traditional and formal majlis seating, and gold or brass detailing. It also carries patterned rugs well, which a busier floor decor would fight with.

Pale, low-contrast white oak SPC. The quietest floor in the range for minimal interiors.

This is the quietest decor we stock. The grain is subtle and the contrast between light and dark within each plank is deliberately low, so the floor recedes and lets furniture, art and joinery do the talking.

That restraint is the point. In a minimal interior a busy floor with strong grain becomes the loudest thing in the room, which is rarely what the design intended. We fit a lot of this in apartments and in rooms where the client has spent their budget on the furniture.
Why choose a floor with less grain?

So it does not compete. In a minimal room a strongly grained floor becomes the busiest surface in the space. A low-contrast decor lets the furniture and the architecture read clearly, which is usually the whole intent of the scheme.
Less than a grey. It is pale but still a warm-neutral rather than a cool one, so it stays comfortable in a room with plenty of light without tipping into the starkness a grey can bring.
Is it practical in a family home?
Yes, with the same caveat as any pale floor: it hides dust well but shows dark spills more clearly. The wear layer handles the traffic; it is a cleaning-habits question, not a durability one.

h2 Where to get Skirting & Nala Profile in Qatar
main: Al Arabia Carpets supplies and installs Skirting & Nala Profile in Doha and across Qatar, with free delivery and installation.
Skirting and nala profiles that finish the floor-to-wall junction and cover expansion gaps.
These are the trims, not the floor. Skirting covers the junction where the flooring meets the wall; nala and transition profiles cover the gaps at doorways, level changes and the edges of a run.

They matter more than they look. Rigid flooring has to be laid with an expansion gap at every wall so it can move with temperature, and the trim is what hides that gap while still letting the floor move underneath. Sealing the floor tight to the wall instead is the usual cause of buckling later.
We colour match the profile to the flooring, or deliberately contrast it where the wall finish calls for that, and fit it as part of the flooring installation.
Why is an expansion gap needed at all?

Rigid flooring expands and contracts with temperature. The gap gives it room to move; the skirting hides the gap without pinning the floor down. Fixing the floor tight to the wall is what causes buckling later.
Can the profile match my flooring?
Yes. We colour match the profile to the flooring you have chosen, or supply a contrasting one if the wall finish suits that better.
Is the trim quoted separately from the floor?
It is normally included in the flooring quote, since it is fitted as part of the same installation.

main: Al Arabia Carpets supplies and installs SPC Zigzag Barkia Installation in Doha and across Qatar, from QAR 75 per sqm, with free delivery and installation.
SPC barkia laid in a zigzag herringbone pattern, cut and angled on site.

This is a laying pattern rather than a different product. The same SPC barkia planks are set at opposing angles so they interlock in a zigzag, which reads as a much more finished floor than a straight run of the identical material.

It is a slower installation. Every plank at the perimeter has to be cut to an angle, the pattern has to be set out from a centre line before anything is fixed, and there is more offcut waste than a straight lay, so both the labour and the material allowance are higher.
The trade-off is that it holds up in large open rooms where a straight lay starts to look flat, and it disguises a room that is slightly out of square better than parallel planks do.
Does the zigzag pattern cost more than a straight lay?
Yes. Every perimeter plank is angle cut and there is more waste, so both the labour and the material allowance are higher than a straight run of the same barkia.
Is the material different from normal SPC barkia?
No. It is the same plank, set at opposing angles. The difference is entirely in how it is laid.
Where does the pattern work best?
In larger or open-plan rooms, where a straight lay tends to look flat. It also disguises a room that is slightly out of square.
